name: DiffuseHigh wavelet guidance detail
plain: During the guidance steps, swaps one DWT band of the denoised prediction for that of the low-res pass, normally the low band, and fades it out by step. This can run on image or latent, with the swap blended by a chosen blend mode. Extends the first pass entry jank-diffusehigh.
math:
k=f−(f/N)·i·fadeout, for i<N. W=DWT(x̂ or D(x̂)). Coeffs=(G_low, W_high), or (W_low, G_high) if flipped.
blend by wavelet, image or latent, at k; then iDWT and encode if image. Optional mask blend.

props.extra_model_calls: optional VAE decode + encode each step

label: from code
